UXUG 2000.title: Cross-disciplinary Design Thinking
UXUG 2000.description: This course aligns with HKUST(GZ)'s mission to cultivate innovative, socially responsible graduates capable of driving positive change. It introduces the principles and practice of design thinking as a human-centered, iterative methodology for solving complex, interdisciplinary problems. In an era defined by rapid technological advancement, the course prepares future leaders to integrate diverse domain knowledge, collaborate effectively across disciplines, and leverage human-AI synergies. Through a project-based approach, students will learn to frame ambiguous problems, empathize with stakeholders, ideate creative solutions, and prototype and test their ideas. Emphasizing teamwork, ethical considerations, and real-world application, the course equips students with the mindset and skills to tackle open-ended challenges spanning technology, society, and sustainability. Graded P or F.
